enabled_tools.name: Enabled Tools
enabled_tools.hint: Select which tools to expose to the AI. Deselect to disable.

zh.name: 启用的工具
zh.hint: 选择要提供给 AI 的工具；取消选择即可禁用对应工具

allowed_sessions.name: Allowed Sessions
allowed_sessions.hint: Allowed sessions in the format of `<adapter_name>:<gm/dm>:<session_id>`

zh.name: 允许的会话
zh.hint: 允许访问的会话，格式为 `<adapter_name>:<gm/dm>:<session_id>`

allowed_exec_sessions.name: Allowed Exec Sessions
allowed_exec_sessions.hint: Allowed sessions to use `exec` tool in the format of `<adapter_name>:<gm/dm>:<session_id>`

zh.name: 允许执行命令的会话
zh.hint: 允许使用 exec 工具的会话，格式为 `<adapter_name>:<gm/dm>:<session_id>`

exec_timeout.name: Exec Timeout
exec_timeout.hint: Maximum runtime in seconds for commands without background mode.

zh.name: 前台命令超时
zh.hint: 未启用后台模式的命令最大运行时间，单位为秒。

background_exec_timeout.name: Background Exec Timeout
background_exec_timeout.hint: Maximum total runtime in seconds for commands in background mode.

zh.name: 后台命令超时
zh.hint: 启用后台模式的命令最大总运行时间，单位为秒。

background_exec_wait_seconds.name: Background Exec Wait Time
background_exec_wait_seconds.hint: How long to wait in seconds for a background command to finish before returning a task ID.

zh.name: 后台命令等待时长
zh.hint: 后台命令开始后等待结果的时长；超过该时长将返回任务 ID，单位为秒。

zh.name: 额外允许的路径
zh.hint: 配置额外允许的路径前缀

extra_read_paths.name: Extra Read Paths
extra_read_paths.hint: Additional allowed path prefixes for read_file and list_files

zh.name: 额外允许读取的路径
zh.hint: read_file 和 list_files 额外允许的路径前缀

extra_write_paths.name: Extra Write Paths
extra_write_paths.hint: Additional allowed path prefixes for write_file and edit_file

zh.name: 额外允许写入的路径
zh.hint: write_file 和 edit_file 额外允许的路径前缀
